reviews.title: Kurier kradnie zamówienie, a firma rozklada rece…
reviews.text: Jestem bardzo rozczarowana działaniami tej firmy… zamówiliśmy z narzeczonym zakupy przez aplikację… był czas oczekiwania ok godziny, za jakies 30 minut od zamówienia ponownie zerknęliśmy do aplikacji… zamówienie „dostarczone”, nie było ani dzwonka, ani telefonu, zerknęłam na klatkę a tam pusto zarówno pod drzwiami jak i koło domofonu… od razu napisalismy w czacie ze zamówienie nie dotarło, jednak tylko zgłoszenie zostało wysłane. Po około 2 dniach otrzymałam informację, że przepraszają i jaki zwrot kosztów preferujemy- czy na konto glovo czy bankowe- po informacji, że oczekujemy zwrotu na konto bankowe, narracja się zmieniła, kilkukrotnie prosiliśmy ich o udowodnienie dostarczenia zamówienia, skoro odmawiają zwrotu środków, jednak kopiowali ciągle tą samą odpowiedź, bez żadnych konkretów- nie mozemy zwrocic i tyle. Nie są w stanie przedstawić dowodów na dostarczenie tym samym odmawiając zwrotu środków za NIEZREALIZOWANE ZAMÓWIENIE. Dodatkowo użyliśmy wtedy kodu zniżkowego od pewnego sławnego influencera, to bylo pierwsze zamówienie z tego punktu. Narazie zgłosiliśmy sprawę do rzecznika i UOKiK, nie zostawimy tego tak na pewno.

reviews.title: Drugie zamówienie w życiu i klapa

Kurier jechał po nie ze Świętochłowic, ale w pewnym momencie „zniknął” z mapy. Od tej pory pojawiał się komunikat o tym, że zamówienie zostanie wkrótce odebrane przez kuriera. Minął czas otwarcia lokalu (była godzina 00:10). Dopóki nie skontaktowałem się z asystentem Ai nie otrzymałem informacji, czy zostanie ono zrealizowane. Wtedy asystent dopiero „ogarnął”, że nie zostanie i zamówienie to anulował. Zdecydowanie nie polecam.

Znacząco pogorszyła się też obsługa klienta - nie ma możliwości kontaktu z działem wsparcia, można jedynie wybierać z predefiniowanych opcji które często nie zawierają odpowiednich opcji. reviews.title: Need a local phonenumber
reviews.text:
You need a local phone number to be able to use the app. It will verify your bank card but it won't let you place an order without a phone number. When you try to contact customer support, they will repeatedly tell you that they can't have a conversation with you without a verified phone number and eventually they'll tell you to get an eSIM or get a local friend's number. Very tourist-unfriendly, very digital nomad-unfriendly, despite the fact they operate in 21 countries. 

Zero out of ten support experience. They send stock messages that are unhelpful and immediately close the conversation.

reviews.title: Consegna prioritaria pagata, panino arrivato freddo un ora e mezza in ritardo dall accordato
reviews.text:
Ho ordinato da Burger King alle 18:40 per cenare verso le 19. Glovo indicava la consegna tra le 19:00 e le 19:15, quindi ho pagato il supplemento per la priorità e ho lasciato anche il 10% di mancia in anticipo. Da lì, la stima è slittata prima alle 19:20, poi alle 19:30 e infine alle 20 circa.
Il rider ha accettato l’ordine mentre era in zona Padenghe. Dalla mappa l’ho visto fare diversi giri prima di arrivare al Burger King alle 19:44. Dopo aver ritirato il panino, si è fermato anche al centro commerciale Le Vele prima di consegnarmelo. Quando è arrivato, il panino era freddo.
A quel punto, dei 1,50 € restituiti mi interessa ben poco. Volevo cenare alle sette e mi sono ritrovato a mangiare un panino freddo col nervoso, dopo aver pagato pure la priorità e lasciato la mancia. Per un servizio del genere mi aspetto il rimborso dell’intero ordine. Quanto alla mancia, dopo questa esperienza la lascerò solo a consegna fatta.

reviews.title: Absolutely Disgraceful Service – No Food, No Refund, No Customer Support!
reviews.text:
One of the worst food delivery experiences I have ever had. Absolutely disgraceful service from Glovo!

During my recent trip to Georgia, I ordered food to my hotel and provided clear delivery instructions, including the floor and room number. The hotel allowed delivery drivers to come directly to guests’ rooms without needing permission from reception. I even paid an additional tip to the driver to bring the food upstairs.

Despite all this, I waited for over an hour, only for my order to be cancelled without any reasonable explanation. The most ridiculous part is that I actually went downstairs, found the delivery driver at the hotel and personally told him that I was the customer waiting for the order. Instead of handing over my food, he repeatedly said “No, no, no” and walked away!

How can a delivery driver physically meet the customer, refuse to hand over the food and then leave without delivering the order?

As if that was not bad enough, I contacted Glovo’s customer support to explain what had happened. I received absolutely no meaningful response, no explanation and no resolution. Several days have now passed, and I STILL HAVE NOT RECEIVED MY REFUND.

This is completely unacceptable. I paid for food I never received, wasted over an hour of my holiday waiting, and was then completely ignored by customer support.

What exactly am I paying for? A delivery service that does not deliver? A customer support team that does not respond? A company that fails to return custome

reviews.title: Apoio ao cliente inexistente
reviews.text:
É lamentável a forma como a Glovo trata os seus clientes.

No dia 7 de novembro, fiz um pedido de duas pizzas, no valor de 14,13 €. As pizzas foram transportadas e entregues na vertical, dentro de um simples saco de alças, quando deveriam ter sido mantidas na horizontal. O resultado? As duas pizzas chegaram completamente desmoronadas e sem condições de apresentação.

Naturalmente, apresentei uma reclamação e enviei fotografias a comprovar o sucedido. O mais inacreditável veio depois: recebi duas respostas através da aplicação e uma terceira por e-mail, todas de colaboradores diferentes, mas exatamente com o mesmo conteúdo. Três respostas padronizadas, sem uma explicação concreta, sem demonstrarem que compreenderam o problema e, acima de tudo, sem qualquer preocupação em encontrar uma solução.

Pergunto: para que serve o apoio ao cliente se ninguém se dá ao trabalho de analisar verdadeiramente uma situação apresentada por um cliente?

Não se trata apenas dos 14,13 €. Trata-se de responsabilidade, respeito pelo consumidor e qualidade do serviço prestado.

Já não espero muito do apoio ao cliente, mas considero que a Glovo deve perceber que não basta enviar pedidos de desculpa automáticos para resolver problemas reais.

Uma empresa que trabalha diariamente com milhares de clientes deveria ter mais consideração por quem utiliza e paga pelos seus serviços.

reviews.title: Extremely disappointing experience with Glovo
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience with Glovo. Our food was collected by the courier, but instead of delivering it, Glovo assigned him another order and sent him to a different restaurant. He spent over 40 minutes there while our food was getting cold.

This is not the restaurant's fault — it is Glovo's delivery system that caused the problem. We paid for freshly prepared food and received a cold, ruined meal.

What is the point of Glovo Prime if the service cannot even deliver food in a reasonable time? I am cancelling my subscription and will no longer use Glovo.

Absolutely unacceptable service. I would not recommend Glovo to anyone.

reviews.title: Zimne jedzenie
reviews.text:
Bardzo słaba obsługa ze strony Glovo. Zamówiłem burgery, jednak przez ponad 30 minut nie potrafiono znaleźć kuriera. Zamiast skontaktować się ze mną i zaproponować anulowanie zamówienia, Glovo zdecydowało się dostarczyć jedzenie po 45 minutach – oczywiście całkowicie zimne.

Najgorsze jest jednak podejście do klienta. Firma nie poczuwa się do żadnej odpowiedzialności, nie proponuje rekompensaty, a złożenie reklamacji jest praktycznie niemożliwe.

Klient płaci za usługę dostarczenia jedzenia, a nie za otrzymanie zimnego posiłku z opóźnieniem. Kompletny brak profesjonalizmu, odpowiedzialności i szacunku do klienta. Zdecydowanie nie polecam.

reviews.title: Horrible Riders
reviews.text:
Great food and offers BUT HORRIBLE RIDERS unfortunately.
Almost every day I make two orders to Port Olimpic, Barcelona and it’s a struggle, every single day, almost every time!
Even though I leave clear instructions in both English and Spanish on how to get into the harbour, send a map showing the bicycle entrance so they don’t have to take the stairs, and a photo of the office so they cannot miss it, they still act as if they cannot find it.
They just cannot be bothered to read the instructions or even look at the photos; they stop on top of the stairs looking at the harbour from above and start bombarding me with messages on how they cannot find it.
Every single time. Almost no exceptions.
It makes the experience very unpleasant, and it’s a shame.

reviews.text: I’ve placed an order from home to a restaurant 10 minutes away from my home in a large city centre. The order was supposed to be delivered in an hour. After around 40 minutes, my order was delayed by another one and a half hour. I had to leave home by then, but it turns out, there was a cancellation fee. There shouldn’t be one, since it’s not my fault glovo suddenly couldn’t find a driver. I’ve cancelled the order and called customer service for a refund. The customer service lied (and insisted!) that the fee was correct, since the driver was already on his way. Clearly he couldn’t have been, since it doesn’t take 1h:30min to do 10 minutes drive. Won’t use this app again.

reviews.title: Paghi e perdi soldi. Assistenza inesistente e ordini incompleti 🤬
reviews.text:
Esperienza  pessima. Glovo è un servizio inaffidabile: prodotti che mancano spesso dagli ordini, soldi persi e praticamente impossibilità di contattare un operatore per risolvere i problemi. Quando qualcosa va storto, ottenere assistenza diventa un’impresa e non si riesce ad avere una soluzione concreta.

È assurdo pagare per un ordine e ritrovarsi con prodotti mancanti senza riuscire a parlare con qualcuno che possa aiutarti. Si paga per ricevere un servizio completo, non per perdere soldi e tempo.

Vergognoso il modo in cui viene gestita l’assistenza clienti. Incassare i soldi è facile, ma quando c’è un problema sembra impossibile trovare qualcuno disposto a risolverlo.

Non consiglio questo servizio. Mai più!

Estafetas que andam às voltas num trajeto que é sempre em frente, excedem o tempo de entrega, e mesmo muitas das vezes nem entrega, e não há nada na app para ajudar. O setor de “ajuda” limita-se a um conjunto de perguntas programadas, que nestes casos, em pedidos que já passam da hora suposta e vê-se ou o estafeta parado, ou a andar às voltas nas ruas onde a está, com a indicação que o pedido está a caminho, não nos permite falar nem com nenhum agente, nem outra solução. Os estafetas muitas vezes não atendem ou não respondem, e nisto já se passaram mais 25 min ou mais, da suposta hora de entrega.
Não há nenhum email, contacto, nada. Façam melhor porque nestas situações não há ninguém da glovo para ajudar

reviews.title: Automated to the point of failure
reviews.text:
This is far from the first time Glovo has made a mistake with my order, and it’s becoming a pattern. This time, after waiting nearly 2 hours, an item worth 37 PLN was missing from my order. Instead of refunding the 37 PLN I paid for an item I never received, I was offered a 2.70 PLN coupon.

I’m sure that if someone added up all the times I’ve been short-changed on orders, it would amount to a pretty significant sum. What’s equally frustrating is how refunds are handled. Rather than simply returning money to the payment method used, the system often pushes coupons to your email, requiring extra effort to access your own money while conveniently keeping funds within their ecosystem.

Meanwhile, Glovo continues to add fees, surcharges, and paid options like Priority Delivery, yet the service and support seem to be getting worse. Mistakes happen, but repeatedly under-refunding customers and making it difficult to recover their money is not acceptable. Of course there is no way to contact anyone because it is all walled off so you can sit there and wonder if it’s worth the hassle to even peruse the money owed. 

Great job guys, keep it up!

reviews.text:
I used a lot Glovo to order groceries. I even had “prime” for a year or something. But a couple of times I faced similar issues - you order, wait for a while, and then get nothing. Usually it happens at the time when you need food quickly. And usually you know that after you write to a support. For example, today - I ordered groceries with delivery time 5pm. When I wrote to them at 7pm (still without an order) - they tried to hurry up the courier and then order was canceled because of “technical error”. I waited for 3 hours to receive nothing. 
Also one time courier sold my pizza and only after speaking with support 3rd or 4rd courier delivered pizza and told me that story. It also took a lot of hours. 
Also regarding the app itself - only with Glove there is a problem when you place your order during some time (to pick all the groceries) and when you finish- you quite often may see that store is not available yet. Very great spending of time 💪🏼
Or you may order things but they are not available yet in the store. What is wrong with the API you use? Why Wolt or Uber don’t have this problems? 
I would never use this app again, but I don’t see alternatives in terms of Auchan and Biedronka. 
I wish you improve your service - to control the time of each order. To control the couriers that you use and their actual work. To notify user when store closes soon and fix all the other small bugs. 
Or there’ll be better app alternatives with all the grocery stores

reviews.title: Maus procedimentos
reviews.text:
A Glovo permite que o estafeta aceite entregas sem estar em condições de as entregar.
Resultado:
O estafeta estava no restaurante, aceitou a entrega, foi fazer quatro ou cinco entregas, e só depois voltou ao restaurante para levantar a minha entrega.
Ou seja, atrasou a entrega em quase uma hora quando poderia ter deixado que outro estafeta tivesse apanhado a encomenda mais cedo.

This is already the third time I’m having serious issues with orders made via Glovo, and my conclusion is simple – the way this service treats its customers is terrible.

Every time there are delays and problems with orders from different restaurants, but they all have one thing in common – Glovo has no idea how to handle customer complaints properly. Support answers with copy-paste phrases, real issues are not solved, and the compensations they offer are ridiculously small and do not match the time and nerves wasted.

It really feels like the service doesn’t care whether the customer receives the order on time or in a proper condition. The only thing that seems to matter is that the payment went through.
No real responsibility for their partners, no respect for customers, no willingness to look into the situation – only formal replies and symbolic compensation.

After three negative experiences in a row, I have completely lost trust in Glovo.
I do not recommend this service if you value your time, your money, and being treated with basic respect as a customer.
